description: Webhook alerts for 30 days, sent to your https address and signed with a secret you get once. type market_move (market_id, threshold in points, default 15): fires when the odds move that much and when the market resolves. type new_market (keyword, optional category): fires when a matching market is created. A test ping must get a 2xx answer or you are not charged. Costs $0.10 (x402, USDC).

category.description: football, sports, fighting, culture, politics, crypto, finance, fun or other

name: alert_subscribe
